module_summary: AXI-Lite 1-to-NS splitter for always-ready slaves: registered address decoders produce one-hot M valids, per-slave responses are muxed by registered index into B/R FIFOs with outstanding-count backpressure.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Write address valid into awskid skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Write address buffered then decoded to slave select

anchors.name: S_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Write data valid gating M_AXI_AWVALID and decoder release

anchors.name: S_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: Write ready when decoded address is valid

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Write data passed straight to M_AXI_WDATA

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid when bfifo non-empty

anchors.name: S_AXI_BREADY
anchors.why: Pops bfifo and decrements write_count

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Read address fed to read address decoder

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Read request valid into decoder and read counter

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Read ready unless read outstanding count full

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Read data from rfifo output

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read response valid when rfifo non-empty

anchors.name: S_AXI_RREADY
anchors.why: Pops rfifo and decrements read_count

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: One-hot per-slave write valid from wdecode gated by WVALID

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Shared write address to all slaves from decoder

anchors.name: M_AXI_BRESP
anchors.why: Per-slave write responses selected by write_bindex

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: One-hot per-slave read valid from rdecode

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Shared read address to all slaves

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Concatenated per-slave read data sliced by last_read_index

anchors.name: M_AXI_RRESP
anchors.why: Per-slave read responses selected by index

anchors.name: wdecode
anchors.why: One-hot write slave select plus no-slave bit from address decoder

anchors.name: rdecode
anchors.why: One-hot read slave select plus no-slave bit from address decoder

anchors.name: awskid_valid
anchors.why: Buffered write address valid into decoder and write counter

anchors.name: write_awskidready
anchors.why: Accepts buffered AW when W progressing and B space available

anchors.name: dcd_awvalid
anchors.why: Decoded write address valid driving write ready

anchors.name: read_rwait
anchors.why: Decoded read valid starting the read return pipeline

anchors.name: write_bindex
anchors.why: Registered slave index selecting M_AXI_BRESP slice

anchors.name: last_read_index
anchors.why: Registered slave index selecting RDATA/RRESP slice

anchors.name: write_no_index
anchors.why: No slave matched; forces interconnect error write response

anchors.name: read_no_index
anchors.why: No slave matched; forces interconnect error read response

anchors.name: write_resp
anchors.why: Registered selected write response pushed into bfifo

anchors.name: write_response
anchors.why: Delayed write strobe pushing write_resp into bfifo

anchors.name: read_rdata
anchors.why: Registered selected read data pushed into rfifo

anchors.name: read_resp
anchors.why: Registered selected read response pushed into rfifo

anchors.name: read_result
anchors.why: Delayed read strobe writing data into rfifo

anchors.name: write_count
anchors.why: Outstanding write count bounding bfifo occupancy

anchors.name: bfull
anchors.why: Write count full; blocks AW acceptance

anchors.name: read_count
anchors.why: Outstanding read count bounding rfifo occupancy

anchors.name: read_full
anchors.why: Read count full; deasserts ARREADY

groups.name: Write address decode
groups.description: Skid-buffered AW decoded into one-hot slave write valids

groups.name: Write data pass-through
groups.description: W channel forwarded to all slaves, ready from decoded address

groups.name: Write response return
groups.description: Selects slave BRESP by index into bfifo with outstanding count

groups.name: Read address decode
groups.description: AR decoded into one-hot slave read valids

groups.name: Read data return
groups.description: Muxes slave read data by index into rfifo with outstanding count
